_about: Checkable appointment constraints, transcribed from the 'trap' text of labels_sample.json. The official labels only say which action is expected (e.g. book_appointment); these constraints let the evaluation check that the booking itself is right. Each field is optional.

M002.source: Must find the existing Wed 11 Nov booking and a free Friday afternoon slot with KIM.

M015.source: Sick visit with KIM today or tomorrow.

M024.source: Needs a 40-minute KIM slot this week.

M034.source: Week of 23 Nov; 26-27 Nov are holidays.

M039.source: Sick visit within 1 business day, ideally with OKAFOR (provider preference not enforced).
